text:
liz: heads-up: strict fncall validator rolled to 10% in eu-west and we're getting a small but consistent stream of rejects for `search_tool` where clients send `result: null` instead of `result.items: []`
omar: saw it. reject-rate ~2.3% in canary. sample payloads show older SDKs doing null semantics
rachel: did we ship a schema change recently? i thought null was allowed as an implicit empty set
omar: schema tightened last sprint as part of typed-output work, might be unintended break
tyler: ops tradeoffs: (1) revert to permissive for just this tool in canary, (2) keep strict but route failing requests to a coercion adapter that transforms null->[] and emit a `validator_action=coerce` tag
liz: prefer (2) if it's low-risk because it keeps canary coverage and gives us data, but we must surface it in console and mark billing path
omar: telemetry: emit metric `fncall.rejects.count` with tag `reason=missing_items` and label `coercion_candidate=true`. sample 150 events to our payload bucket
rachel: console: add a per-tool toggle "tolerant-mode" that switches coercion on/off and shows recent sampled payloads + request_ids. product owners can flip it during incidents
tyler: billing note: coerced accepts still consume tokens. add `billing_path=coercion` tag when we coerce so finance can filter later
deploy-bot: canary-update: strict-fncall-validator canary=10% started 2026-03-20T09:17:00Z
liz: immediate plan: enable coercion adapter for `search_tool` in eu-west canary, turn on sampling, and add the `validator_action` tag. pause further strict validator rollouts until owners are notified
omar: i'll push the adapter and sampling now, will also record `validator_action=soft_accept` for these flows
rachel: i'll prototype the console toggle and the sampled payload view; can ship a temporary flag in ~2h
tyler: i'll make sure route_id/billing tags are added and communicate with finance about meter implications
liz: who is oncall for the next 6h in case noise spikes?
tyler: i'm oncall for 6h
liz: ok thanks. keep logs & incident doc updated and ping #incidents if any user-facing failures. :thumbsup:
